_comment: Sample books used by the autotests, by role. The files live in samples/ (not in the repository). To use other books, change the file names; 'about' says what the tests expect from each book.

fb2.about: Main FB2: a long book with a table of contents (20+ entries), footnotes and a few images

fb2Images.about: FB2 with many images (dozens) and footnotes

fb2Extra.about: Any other FB2 with a table of contents

epub.about: Main EPUB: a table of contents, footnotes; a title that differs from the file name

pdf.about: PDF with a text layer, no table of contents, a picture on the cover, a Latin file name

pdfScan.file: Чандлер Д. Военные кампании Наполеона (1999), OCR.pdf
pdfScan.about: Scanned PDF with pages of different sizes

djvu.about: Main DjVu: a text layer and a table of contents; a picture on the cover

djvuLarge.about: A large DjVu (hundreds of pages) with a table of contents
